nodes.description: Memory has been expanded to accommodate data

nodes.label: Read Data from Memory
nodes.description: Read specified number of bytes starting at position

sub_graphs.title: Prague VM Memory: Buffer Read with Zero-Padding
sub_graphs.description: Models the buffer_read operation that handles out-of-bounds reads safely

nodes.label: Buffer Read Requested
nodes.description: Request to read bytes from a buffer at specified offset and size

nodes.label: Check Buffer Bounds
nodes.description: Determine if read extends beyond buffer boundaries

nodes.label: Read Within Bounds
nodes.description: Read bytes directly when fully within buffer

nodes.label: Apply Zero Padding
nodes.description: Pad with zeros for bytes requested beyond buffer end

sub_graphs.title: Prague VM Memory: Gas Cost Implications
sub_graphs.description: Models the relationship between memory operations and gas costs (structural, as gas calculation details not in this module)

nodes.label: Memory Operation Pending
nodes.description: Memory operation requested but gas not yet charged

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion
nodes.description: Determine if operation requires memory expansion beyond current size

nodes.label: Charge Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Deduct gas for expanding memory (quadratic cost component)

nodes.label: Gas Charged for Memory
nodes.description: Expansion gas deducted, operation can proceed

ambiguities.text: The specification does not include memory expansion logic or gas cost calculations in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume memory expansion and gas costs are handled in separate modules (gas.py or similar) and memory.py only handles raw byte operations

ambiguities.text: The position parameter is U256 but practical memory size is limited - unclear what happens with very large positions
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume memory expansion gas costs make very large positions economically infeasible; practical limit enforced via gas

ambiguities.text: buffer_read uses 'a utility method' for alignment but the specific method is not named
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to right_pad_zero_bytes or similar utility for zero-padding short reads

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is always initialized as an empty bytearray at the start of each EVM execution context
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Uninitialized memory could leak data between transactions or contract calls

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory expansion gas is charged before the write operation occurs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If write happens before gas check, failed transactions could still modify memory state

implicit_assumptions.description: Position and size parameters have been validated or gas-bounded before reaching memory functions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Maliciously large values could cause memory exhaustion or DoS
